description: A date typo far ahead (see main.zhang): the filters that bound the months #budgets generates (date <= x, date < x, date = x, yearmonth(date) = x or <= x, today(), on either side, after a conjunct that cannot fail) answer, the others fail as too large.

requests.bql: SELECT name, date, currency, alias, category, accounts, close, close_time FROM #budget_definitions
SELECT name, date, time, timestamp, type, amount FROM #budget_events
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND date <= 2024-03-01
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND date < 2024-03-01
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND date = 2024-02-01
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND yearmonth(date) = 2024-02-01
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND yearmonth(date) <= 2024-02-01
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND 2024-02-01 >= date
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE name = 'b00' AND date <= today()
SELECT name, date, available FROM #budgets WHERE date = yearmonth(today()) AND name = 'b00'
SELECT name, date FROM #budgets WHERE year = 2024
SELECT name, date FROM #budgets WHERE date >= 2024-01-01 AND date <= 2024-02-01
